policy: One row per blueprint. `body: committed` means the source states a licence that permits redistribution and the file lives under bodies/. `body: reference` means the body is NOT in this repo -- materialise.py fetches or copies it at use time and verifies the sha256 recorded here. See PROVENANCE.md for the licence position per source.
